phases.name: Evaluation
phases.objective: Build a fixed measuring stick before improving anything.
phases.work: A frozen 400-question eval set across 8 categories (arithmetic, multi-step, logic, patterns, general knowledge, instruction following, reading, coding) plus eval.py, which scores any checkpoint the same way every time.
phases.outcome: Baseline measured: v0 scored 17.0%. The eval was frozen — it is never re-tuned against.
phases.lesson: You can't improve what you can't measure. Every later phase is judged by this one file.

phases.name: Dataset
phases.work: A 10k-example reasoning dataset (aizen_phase2_train.txt) with multi-step arithmetic, logic and instruction-following formats, generated synthetically and validated.
phases.lesson: Data quality moves a small model more than anything else — capacity is too scarce to waste on noise.

phases.name: Training
phases.objective: Fine-tune without destroying what the model already knew.
phases.work: train_phase3.py: answer-masked loss (only answer tokens count), example-aligned windows, 70/30 new/old data mix. A follow-up 5k targeted-fix dataset (Phase 3b) attacked the specific failure cases.
phases.outcome: 17.0% → 26.5% (v1) → 28.75% (v1b). Fixes came with regressions — a see-saw between categories.
phases.lesson: Fine-tuning a tiny model is whack-a-mole: every fix can break something else. Measure everything.

phases.name: BPE
phases.objective: Stop wasting the model on spelling.
phases.work: A BPE tokenizer written from scratch (tokenizer.py): 2048 merges, digits kept as single tokens, full printable-ASCII base — plus a context extension from 192 to 512 tokens and a full scratch retrain.
phases.outcome: 35.75% (v2). Reading comprehension jumped from 16 → 38, instruction following 12 → 32.
phases.lesson: Representation matters. The same parameters go much further when they don't have to learn characters.

phases.name: Pretraining
phases.objective: Give the model English before asking it questions.
phases.work: 103MB of TinyStories cleaned to ASCII, a 4096-vocab tokenizer v2, 26.2M tokens pretrained for 16k steps as a plain language model, then a 2.5k-step masked-QA fine-tune.
phases.outcome: 45.25% (v3) — current best. Logic exploded from 12 → 66; the pretrained model writes coherent stories.
phases.lesson: Pretraining is not optional, even at 16M params. Comprehension comes from reading, not from Q&A pairs.

phases.name: Hybrid data
phases.objective: Mix curated public data with synthetic.
phases.work: Added bAbI reading and deduction tasks from HuggingFace alongside new synthetic patterns and 3-digit arithmetic. The first attempt over-diluted the mix; capping bAbI at 2,400 examples fixed it.
phases.lesson: Proportion matters as much as presence — the same data at the wrong dosage made things worse before it made them better.

phases.name: Conversation
phases.work: 2,500 multi-turn blocks so follow-ups like “and plus 3?” resolve against the previous answer, plus negative results and syllogisms with false premises. Every answer turn is masked for loss.
phases.outcome: Overall dipped to 48.0% (v5) while the model learned to hold a conversation — a deliberate trade.
phases.lesson: Not every step is a benchmark step. Some capabilities cost points on the ruler before they pay off.

phases.name: Scale finale
phases.work: 12 layers, 512 dim, 8 heads, pretrained on ~200MB of TinyStories (52.5M tokens, 16k steps), then fine-tuned 5k steps on the full task pool. Two bugs caught first: a per-chunk reseeding flaw that had been shrinking every resumed run, and silent Metal GPU memory corruption above batch ~20.
phases.outcome: 60.75% (v6) — every category at an all-time high: arithmetic 100, multi-step 82, logic 72, reading 68, patterns 48.
phases.lesson: The see-saw finally stopped. With enough capacity, gains in one category stopped costing another — and changing one variable at a time is what made the result believable.
